children.name: up
children.tooltip: Transpose the pattern up a note

children.name: down
children.tooltip: Transpose the pattern down a note

children.name: trig
children.tooltip: Under the external clock, select the pattern by the trigger's pitch rather than resetting on its level

children.name: notecut
children.tooltip: Cut the note on a new step

children.name: grid
children.tooltip: Click a step on or off, or click and drag right for a longer note; drag a note's right edge to change its length; right-drag or scroll a note to set its volume; the shaded note names are the rows sending Triggers 1 to 16: click or drag there to move them

panel.help: A step sequencer: each column is a step, each row a note. View picks the pattern you edit, Play the one that plays. Right-drag or scroll an on step to set its volume. Pat Seq lists the patterns played in turn; -1 ends it. The square button steps through the layouts.
